title: Supreme Court: In re Grand Jury
summary: Certiorari dismissed as improvidently granted. (No. 21-1397, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 598 U.S. 15).

title: Supreme Court: Arellano v. McDonough
summary: The effective date of an award of service-related disability compensation to a veteran of the United States military determined pursuant to 38 U. S. C. §§5110(a)(1) and 5110(b)(1) is not subject to equitable tolling. (No. 21-432, opinion by Justice Barrett; 598 U.S. 1).
